blocks.text: Perimeter policies allow you to easily define how Microsegmentation handles inbound, outbound, and internal traffic for managed resource groups. You can create perimeter policies on the Perimeter Policies page in the Zscaler Admin Console.
The Perimeter Policies page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View high-level and in-depth information about the perimeter policies configured for your resource groups.
Create, edit, and delete perimeter policies to meet your organization's requirements.

blocks.text: On the Perimeter Policies page (Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Perimeter Policies), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Refresh the page to reflect the most current information.

Filter the information in the table. After configuring your preferred filters, click the button to apply the filters (e.g., Apply 1 filter, Apply 2 filters) and view the results. By default, no filters are applied.
View a list of all perimeter policies that are configured for your organization. For each perimeter policy, you can see:
Name: The name of the perimeter policy.
Resource Group: The resource group associated with the perimeter policy.
App Zone: The AppZones associated with the perimeter policy.
Rule Action: The actions the perimeter policy takes on inbound, outbound, and internal traffic.
Click an individual perimeter policy to view its complete information.
Click an individual resource group to view its complete information.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
